pageProps.title: KURIMU Melbourne Central
pageProps.review: A place I kept noticing while wandering around Melbourne. A great quick snack when you're craving something sweet — the taste is exactly what you'd expect from a cream puff. It's a Japanese-style choux cream — a crisp choux pastry shell packed with custard cream.
